hypothesis: Five consecutive canonical-regime decisions opposed to an open position, combined with a completed-close loss threshold of 20 to 50 bps, can improve v51 exits without damaging route expectancy.
decision: Do not add this rule globally or to Range Onset. The pooled 20-bps result is largest-winner dependent, the exact HYPE transfer already failed later confirmation, and both currently open Range Onset paths would have exited at worse modeled prices. Reopen only with new, technically complete route-native evidence.
falsifier: Reopen only if a predeclared route-specific sample with exact completed-bar decisions, next-open execution, actual fees, funding and slippage is positive after largest-winner removal, stable across non-adjacent windows and sides, and improves the frozen control without worsening drawdown materially.

exact_v51_opp5_loss20.assessment: one improved large loss does not establish a route rule

range_onset_closed.assessment: loss reduced but sample is one historical small-notional lifecycle

recommendation.recommendation: Retain the current v51 exit contracts and continue exact route-native observation.
recommendation.why_now: The open ETH and SOL Range Onset lifecycles exposed a plausible regime-opposition exit hypothesis, while the current-profile HYPE loss made the pooled result appear attractive.
evidence_reviewed: two exact current-run open Range Onset paths
one historical closed Range Onset lifecycle
frozen HYPE compression development and later-confirmation exit replay
recommendation.observed_problem_or_opportunity: Persistent regime opposition can identify some losing paths, but the proposed rule also exits recovering positions and converts some winners to losses.
recommendation.applicable_market_regime: Evidence spans mixed historical regimes; the two open Range Onset observations are long positions under persistent opposed structure and cannot establish behavior in other regimes or on shorts.
alternatives_considered: retain current route exits and collect resolved route-native closes
recommendation.expected_upside: Avoids applying a pooled, hindsight-formed exit that is not robust and was already falsified on HYPE later confirmation.
recommendation.main_risks_and_failure_modes: Deferral can permit another avoidable stop loss; conversely, premature adoption can crystallize recoverable drawdowns and reduce winners. Open-path marks are time-sensitive and not realized outcomes.
recommendation.validation_completed: Completed-close causality, next-open pricing, missing-decision handling, exact v51 identity, current open-path replay, largest-winner sensitivity, and independent HYPE later confirmation were checked.
recommendation.validation_still_required: Technically resolved Range Onset closes on both sides and non-adjacent regimes, exact funding and fill friction, route-specific drawdown, and predeclared forward comparison against the unchanged control.
recommendation.success_metrics: Positive route-specific net and profit factor above one; positive after largest-winner removal; majority positive non-adjacent folds; no material drawdown degradation; exact lifecycle coverage; no side collapse.
recommendation.failure_or_rollback_triggers: Any later live proposal must roll back if after-cost route net, ex-largest net, fold stability, or technical completeness falls below its frozen acceptance contract.
recommendation.confidence_level: high for no global change; medium for continued Range Onset observation; low for current route profitability

single_highest_value_next_investigation: Resolve the current ETH and SOL Range Onset lifecycles, then compare their actual provider exit, stop, funding, MFE, MAE, giveback, and counterfactual policies without selecting from the open path.
limitations: The hypothesis was formed after observing live opposition and is not predeclared for the existing paths.
The all-live result pools incompatible strategies, sizing, profiles, and regimes.
The exact v51 closed sample is five and Range Onset has no v51 close yet.
Open-path counterfactuals are not realized PnL and will change as the positions evolve.
No live strategy, asset, route, parameter, leverage, sizing, risk, execution, exit, or deployment configuration changed.
